src/assembly.jl:739-745 raises StoreWithoutUpdate only when neither x_deriv nor s_update exists, and the message at src/diagnostics.jl:548 says 'defines neither `x_deriv` nor `s_update`'. Probe P1: x_init holding a store with s_update and no x_deriv gives DeclarationOnWrongTier on x_init, not StoreWithoutUpdate. P1b: a store with no update law gives StoreWithoutUpdate.
judgments.fix: A state declaration holding a store needs its update. `x_init` or `s_init` holding a store, on a primitive that defines neither `x_deriv` nor `s_update`, is a build error, `StoreWithoutUpdate`. A store beside the other tier's update law is `DeclarationOnWrongTier` (below).
judgments.note: spec:3512 already rules the mixed case (an x_init on a primitive whose update law is s_update) as DeclarationOnWrongTier, which agrees with the code. The two sentences overlap, and only 3474 read literally disagrees.

x_projection casts no tier vote in classify_tier (src/assembly.jl:724-731). Its tier check runs at probe, in probe_stage2 (src/build.jl:1145-1160, reason :continuous_only or :no_manifold), after the structure step. Probe P3: a discrete primitive with x_projection fails with the carrier's structure set, so it passed the structure step. P3b: with m_init also declared, only m_init is reported and x_projection is not reported with it.
judgments.fix: `m_init` and `state_events` are continuous-only, because the event system is continuous-side only, and their disagreement is checked in the structure step. `x_projection` is continuous-only too, because projection's one manifold is the continuous state's. It casts no tier vote, and the probe refuses it on a discrete primitive, or on one with no continuous state, as `DeclarationOnWrongTier` ([§9.3][s9-3]).
judgments.note: spec:3469 ('three rules in the structure step') needs the same change. Nothing in the log or pending.md records moving the x_projection check to probe, so the user may instead want the check moved into classify_tier.
